title: Theater Screen Usability and Entertainment
summary: Reviews discuss the theater screen as an in-car entertainment feature, with praise for comfort and enjoyment but also complaints about usability, app limitations, and connectivity, while many fragments are too brief or task-oriented to determine sentiment clearly.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the theater screen’s comfort, quality, and appeal for passengers and children.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on the theater screen being difficult to use and limited by HDMI and built-in app compatibility.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mainly mention questions, setup issues, offline or lost connections, and general references to the theater screen without enough context for clear sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are labeled undetermined, which limits confidence in identifying clear themes beyond basic usage, enjoyment, and setup concerns.
Several fragments are short or incomplete, so some apparent problems or praise cannot be classified more precisely from the provided text alone.
The topic includes both sentiment-bearing opinions and service-style questions or troubleshooting references, which reduces thematic coherence.
